final: WITH college_income AS (SELECT m2.college, SUM(i.amount) AS income_sum FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member COLLATE BINARY = m.member_id COLLATE BINARY JOIN major AS m2 ON m.link_to_major COLLATE BINARY = m2.major_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY m2.college), totals AS (SELECT SUM(income_sum) AS total_income FROM college_income) SELECT c.college, c.income_sum, c.income_sum * 1.0 / t.total_income FROM college_income AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_income IS NOT NULL
